mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with efavirenz (which has serotonergic and CNS properties) increases risk of serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and severe CNS adverse effects; additionally, efavirenz induces CYP450 enzymes potentially reducing phenelzine levels while efavirenz crosses BBB causing additive neuropsychiatric effects.
action: Avoid concomitant use; if necessary, use alternative antiretroviral with lower CNS/serotonergic activity and ensure adequate washout period (14 days minimum after phenelzine discontinuation before starting efavirenz).
